title: RootSink: Reproducible C/C++ Crashes with Tested Candidate Root-Cause Sites
description: Reproducible C/C++ crashes from OSS-Fuzz (via ARVO) and syzbot, each with a sanitizer-reported sink and a candidate root-cause site whose evidence is stated per record. Each record holds an ordered list of CWE instances with a site and an evidence category per instance, two-sided reproduction logs, single-hunk intervention results, a replay scorer and the versioned labeling rules. Docker images are referenced by digest and are not part of this archive.
